versions.changelog:
- Added `oo-timelink` support for operating Timelink through the OOMOL-connected `oo` CLI.
- Supports fetching clients, companies, projects, services, users, tokens, and time entries.
- Supports listing clients, projects, services, users, active time entries, and time entries with filtering and pagination.
- Supports retrieving required fields for creating time entries.
- Uses live action schemas to validate request payloads before execution.
- Documents authentication, connection setup, billing errors, and read-only safety guidance.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@75bac03`

- Operates Timelink through an OOMOL-connected account using the `oo` CLI, with credentials injected server-side.
- Supports read-only Timelink data access for clients, projects, services, users, time entries, company details, and token metadata.
- Provides list actions with optional filtering and pagination for core Timelink resources.
- Includes helpers for active time entries and required time-entry fields.
- Emphasizes live schema inspection before execution and clear setup guidance for auth, connection, and billing errors.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@146ef20`

- Initial release of the `oo-timelink` skill for operating Timelink through an OOMOL-connected account via the `oo` CLI.
- Provides read access to core Timelink resources, including clients, projects, services, users, company details, API token metadata, and time entries.
- Supports listing Timelink collections with optional filtering and pagination for clients, projects, services, users, and time entries.
- Adds targeted lookup actions for fetching individual clients, projects, services, users, and time entries by identifier.
- Includes support for inspecting active time entries and required fields for time-entry workflows.
- Documents schema-first execution guidance so agents can fetch the live connector contract before constructing action payloads.
